notes: Count over time not shown: the CEC's 2026 results site could not be reached from here (HTTP 403/404, not circumvented) and no archive holds the official count during the night; the only 2026 count we hold is from third-party mirrors licensed for private research only. So the timeline shows Polymarket prices only, and the model's scores are given as aggregates.

Prices: Polymarket books recorded every 30 s on our server from 18:31 UTC 27 Oct to 12:00 UTC 28 Oct; mid if spread <= 10c, else last trade, bounded by the best bid and ask; last value in each minute.

Scores are not pre-registered: settings chosen on the official 2021/2022 counts; config first committed after scoring; scored once on 2026 with post-run data-handling fixes (prereg/NOTES.md, Israel section).
Outcome used for the scores: PROVISIONAL: latest count available (2026-10-28T14:34:23+02:00, 11168 of 12018 regular boxes, double envelopes not yet counted).

Lead = Polymarket settle minus model settle (positive: model first); settled = P(eventual outcome) >= 0.9 from then to 12:00 UTC 28 Oct. Contested markets: 6; median lead +39 min as configured, -28 min if the model waits for 1% counted (a sensitivity added after the first run).

Map: locality polygons (CBS statistical areas 2022, dissolved by locality code); built-up areas only, so regional-council open land between localities is blank. Colour = share of valid votes for the 2022 government bloc (Likud, Religious Zionism-Otzma Yehudit, Shas, UTJ) in the official 2022 final. The 2026 final map is pending the CEC's official final result.

Not on the map: 478,620 of the 2022 valid votes (30 units: the double envelopes of soldiers, diplomats, prisoners etc., and localities such as recognised Bedouin tribes that have no CBS statistical area).
Model only, no market: P(Netanyahu bloc >= 61 seats) ended at 0; outcome no.

kalshi = Kalshi P(candidate a) from 1-minute candles: bid/ask midpoint when the spread is at most 10¢, else the last trade; YES = b markets are inverted. Prices © Kalshi, shown as derived charts with credit.
